entities.name: Jaufré Rudel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaufre Rudel was the prince of Blaye and a troubadour of the early- to mid-12th century, who probably died during the Second Crusade, in or after 1147. He is noted for developing the theme of "love from afar" in his songs.
